name: Cable News Pundit
description: Every cloud is breaking news. Roasts both sides.

storm.head: BREAKING: Sky declares war.
storm.sub: Thunderstorm in {city}. Both parties are blaming each other for the lightning.

storm.head: Thunder, like every comment section.
storm.sub: Lots of noise, lots of heat, nobody's mind is changing. Stay inside.

storm.head: Sources confirm: the sky is furious.
storm.sub: Experts on both sides agree it's loud. They disagree on why. Stay inside.

storm.head: Thunder interrupts again.
storm.sub: The sky has gone over its speaking time. Moderators are powerless.

storm.head: Live team coverage of a cloud.
storm.sub: We've got reporters in raincoats screaming into the wind. Stay home.

storm.head: Developing story: everything is wet and loud.
storm.sub: Our analysts will be wrong about this for hours. Stay in.

storm.head: Thunderous applause. Literally.
storm.sub: The sky is clapping for itself. Stay indoors.

storm.head: Storm declares a state of emergency.
storm.sub: Lawmakers will debate it after it's over. Stay inside.

storm.head: Both sides agree: unplug the TV.

snow.head: Snow is moving faster than any bill in history.
snow.sub: Inches piling up. Congress is still debating the shovel.

snow.head: Snow: finally, a white-out both sides can see.
snow.sub: Roads are bad. Stay home and argue online like normal.

snow.head: Snow forms coalition with cold.
snow.sub: {temp} and falling. Commuters call it an attack on their way of life.

snow.head: Breaking: shovel shortage.
snow.sub: Both parties blame each other. Your driveway doesn't care.

snow.head: Snow totals beat expectations.
snow.sub: Analysts predicted flurries. Analysts were wrong. As usual.

snow.head: Grid-lock, but with snow.
snow.sub: Nothing is moving in {city}. Like every committee ever.

snow.head: Snow covers everything, like the news.
snow.sub: But snow at least eventually melts.

snow.head: Snow: the great equalizer.
snow.sub: Every car is stuck regardless of its bumper stickers.

snow.head: Inches pile up like unread bills.

rain.head: Rain is fully bipartisan today.
rain.sub: Everyone's getting wet. First thing they've agreed on in years.

rain.head: BREAKING: Sky leaks.
rain.sub: {pop}% chance of rain. Sources inside the cloud blame the other guys.

rain.head: Rain leads in every poll.
rain.sub: {pop}% and climbing. Sun campaign in disarray.

rain.head: Rain refuses to concede.
rain.sub: Expected to continue all day. Lawyers are already involved.

rain.head: Soaking: the one bipartisan experience.
rain.sub: Left, right, center: everyone gets wet today.

rain.head: Precipitation hearing runs long.
rain.sub: The sky took the fifth. Bring an umbrella.

rain.head: Rain wins key districts.
rain.sub: Umbrella turnout high. Sun supporters stay home.

rain.head: Deluge of developments.
rain.sub: Literally. It's raining. We'll be right back after this.

rain.head: Wet weather filibuster.
rain.sub: The rain refuses to yield the floor. Expect it all day.

drizzle.head: A light rain of half-truths.
drizzle.sub: Barely anything's falling, yet everyone's acting like it's a scandal.

drizzle.head: Drizzle: the moderate candidate.
drizzle.sub: Nobody's excited, nobody's outraged. Light rain, low turnout.

drizzle.head: Sky issues vague statement.
drizzle.sub: It's sort of raining. Spokespeople declined to clarify.

drizzle.head: Mist polling within margin of error.
drizzle.sub: Is it raining? Statistically, maybe. Hood up.

drizzle.head: Light rain, heavy spin.
drizzle.sub: Some call it a downpour. Some call it a hoax. It's drizzle.

drizzle.head: Damp approval ratings.
drizzle.sub: Nobody loves it. Nobody hates it. Hood up.

fog.head: Visibility: lower than campaign finances.
fog.sub: Thick fog. Nobody knows where anything is going. Very on brand.

fog.head: Fog. Can't see the future. Neither can the polls.
Fog of war. Literally.
fog.sub: Nobody can see anything. Cable news will speculate for hours.

fog.head: Transparency at record low.
fog.sub: Visibility is {vis}. Just like the budget process.

fog.head: Sources say the fog is anonymous.
fog.sub: It won't go on the record. Drive slow.

fog.head: Murky outlook for everyone.
fog.sub: Visibility {vis}. Pollsters say it's too close to call.

windy.head: More hot air than a filibuster.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Hold on to your hat and your opinions.

windy.head: Wind changing direction faster than a senator.
Political winds shifting. Also real winds.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Both are blowing your hat off.

windy.head: Hot air advisory in effect.
windy.sub: Wind at {wind}. Unrelated to any speeches. Probably.

windy.head: Gusts outpace campaign spin.
windy.sub: {gusts} today. Tie down the yard signs.

windy.head: Winds shift. Pundits pivot.
windy.sub: Gusts to {gusts}. Nobody's position holds still.

windy.head: A blustery news cycle.
windy.sub: Wind at {wind}. Hold onto your talking points.

scorching.head: {temp}: hotter than a primary debate.
scorching.sub: Feels like {feels}. Somehow both sides think it proves their point.

scorching.head: Heat dome. Not a policy, sadly.
scorching.sub: Stay inside, drink water, don't get into any arguments, you'll overheat.

scorching.head: Heat wave dominates news cycle.
scorching.sub: {temp}. Every pundit is sweating through their suit on live TV.

scorching.head: Temperatures, like tensions, are high.
scorching.sub: Feels like {feels}. Stay hydrated, stay calm, stay off comment sections.

scorching.head: Hottest take of the day: it's hot.
Heat index tops approval index.
scorching.sub: Feels like {feels}. Hotter than any debate stage.

hot.head: Things are heating up. Literally.
hot.sub: {temp}. Pundits are sweating, and not because of the polls.

hot.head: A heated debate, but outside.
hot.sub: Wear sunscreen. Every party supports sunscreen. Probably.

hot.head: Things are heating up on the trail.
Summer recess energy.
hot.sub: It's {temp}. Nobody wants to work, including the sky.

hot.head: Polls show 100% support for shade.
hot.sub: A rare unanimous decision. High of {high}.

hot.head: A hot summer for everybody.
hot.sub: Both sides are sweating. Literally. High of {high}.

freezing.head: Frozen solid, like the federal budget.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Thaw expected sometime after the next election.

freezing.head: Colder than a filibuster.
freezing.sub: Bundle up. No one is coming to fix this for you.

freezing.head: Cold war. Not that one.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Diplomatic relations with outside: severed.

freezing.head: Freezing, like negotiations.
freezing.sub: Nothing is moving. Not the talks, not your car.

freezing.head: Sky votes for misery.
freezing.sub: Low of {low}. Recount unlikely to change the result.

freezing.head: Ice storm of controversy.
freezing.sub: Feels like {feels}. Mostly the ice part.

freezing.head: Frozen talks, frozen streets.
freezing.sub: Nothing is getting done today. Stay warm.

cold.head: Frosty relations across the aisle and the sidewalk.
cold.sub: {temp}. Wear a jacket, it's a nonpartisan issue.

cold.head: A chilly reception, like a town hall.
cold.sub: High of {high}. Low of {low}. Low expectations overall.

cold.head: Cold shoulder from the sky.
cold.sub: {temp}. Typical of how it treats its constituents.

cold.head: Chilly reception expected.
cold.sub: High of {high}. Jackets are a nonpartisan issue.

cold.head: Breaking: it's sweater season.
cold.sub: Experts on both sides recommend layers.

cold.head: Cold front makes landfall.
cold.sub: Experts disagree on everything except your need for a coat.

nice.head: Perfect weather. Someone will make it a wedge issue.
nice.sub: Enjoy it before the attack ads start.

nice.head: Gorgeous out. Congress will vote to delay it.
nice.sub: {temp} and sunny. Get outside while it's still legal.

nice.head: Nice weather. Nobody knows how to cover it.
nice.sub: No outrage. No scandal. Panelists visibly confused.

nice.head: Perfect day threatens ratings.
nice.sub: {temp} and lovely. Turn off the news and go outside.

nice.head: Sun wins in landslide.
nice.sub: Clouds concede early. Opposition plans to regroup tomorrow.

nice.head: Weather achieves rare unity.
nice.sub: Everyone agrees it's nice. Historians are stunned.

nice.head: Good news, for once.
nice.sub: {temp} and sunny. We don't know what to do with ourselves.

meh.head: Gray skies. Very on-brand for this news cycle.
meh.sub: No highs, no lows, nothing to see. Kind of like the debate.

meh.head: Overcast, like the mood in every newsroom.
Overcast with a chance of nothing.
meh.sub: {temp} and gray. Like a midterm nobody cares about.

meh.head: Status quo maintained.
meh.sub: Nothing changed. Nothing will. Gray all day.

meh.head: The sky abstains.
meh.sub: It's not voting either way. {temp}, cloudy.

meh.head: Mild, moderate, middle-of-the-road.
meh.sub: The centrist sky. Gray and noncommittal.

clearNight.head: Clear skies tonight. At least the stars aren't fundraising.
Tonight's forecast: no spin.
clearNight.sub: Clear and calm. Shame about everything else.

clearNight.head: Polls closed. Sky clear.
clearNight.sub: Results show {temp} and calm. Go to bed, we'll call it in the morning.

clearNight.head: Late-night analysis: it's dark.
clearNight.sub: Clear skies. Our panel will discuss this for six hours.

clearNight.head: No breaking news tonight.
clearNight.sub: Just stars. Enjoy the silence while it lasts.

clearNight.head: Election night energy, minus the yelling.
